name: Talisman of Ultimate Evil

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

magic.attunement: by a creature of evil alignment

powers.name: Fissure of Darkness
powers.text: Magic action, 1 charge: a good creature within 120 ft standing on the ground makes a DC 20 Dex save or falls into a fissure of darkness and is destroyed.

summary: An unholy symbol (+2 spell attacks) with 6 charges that open fissures to swallow good creatures.
text: An emblem of unrepentant evil that sears those unlike it: touching it deals 6d6 Necrotic damage to a creature of neither good nor evil alignment and 8d6 Necrotic damage to a good one. An evil Cleric or Paladin can use it as a holy symbol, gaining +2 to spell attack rolls while wearing or holding it. It holds 6 charges. While the talisman is on you or in hand, a Magic action and 1 charge let you target a creature standing on the ground that you can see within 120 feet; if the target is good, the earth splits open beneath it, and unless it makes a Dexterity saving throw against DC 20 it drops in and is destroyed without a trace. Spending the last charge melts the talisman into stinking slime, destroying it. (Alignment isn't tracked in the game, so Celestials count as good.)
